characters.summary: An alternate, corrupted version of Stephen Strange who absorbed countless mystical beings and creatures to resurrect Christine Palmer, wielding immense dark magic, demonic summoning, and reality-shattering power.
weaknesses: Hubris and emotional vulnerability concerning Christine Palmer
Destruction of his own reality as a consequence of using absolute power
limitations: Prone to catastrophic reality collapse when wielding world-ending magic
characters.formDifferences: Possesses vastly greater destructive power, corruptive dark magic, and absorbed monster traits compared to standard MCU Doctor Strange.
